messages:
alex: Quick question — proposing a tweak to the automatic fallback UI. Instead of one "degrade immediately" toggle, show a small chooser with three clear modes: QUEUE, FAILOVER, SOFT-DEGRADE. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

maria: +1 on clearer names. 'soft-degrade' should have a one-line explainer like 'reduce token count / prefer cheaper model' so people aren't confused.

chen: We need to define concrete triggers. error_count > X, p99 latency threshold, connection failures? Suggest a simple rule editor: metric + comparator + window.

alex: Current draft: triggers are error_count > 5/min OR p99 > 1200ms sustained for 30s. Also need a manual override and an explicit revert policy.

tay: UX note — show an example mapping when users pick FAILOVER: "if trigger -> route to model: rwd-small-quant". People want to see which model gets chosen and why.

sre-pete: Audit must be full: cause, which fallback was selected, metric snapshot at switch time, and link to trace/span. If we don't log that, ops can't debug.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued — automatic-fallback-ui-v2 -> dev cluster (1%), 24h. :rocket:

maria: Also add a 'preview' action in the UI to simulate the trigger without routing traffic. Button runs a small synthetic workload and shows diff in latency & errors.

alex: I like 'preview'. Also show 'estimated cost delta' in the preview so engineers can make a tradeoff decision.

chen: API debate: expose field degrade_mode in the internal rollout API as enum {QUEUE, FAILOVER, SOFT}. Keep existing endpoints backward compatible by mapping previous boolean to FAILOVER.

tay: Telemetry: add breadcrumbs in per-route dashboard (when a fallback was triggered) + a 'rollout timeline' graph showing mode switches over time.

sre-pete: Edge case: cascading fallbacks — if primary fails -> failover model also becomes overloaded, we need TTL and exponential backoff on retries. UX should let users set max depth or fallback chain.

alex: Propose sensible defaults: TTL 10m, backoff factor 1.5x, max fallback depth 2. Expose advanced settings in modal.

maria: Accessibility + copy: modal must be keyboard navigable, and we should add short inline help text for each mode. I'll file a tiny PR for copy tweaks.

chen: I'll update API spec to include degrade_mode enum, triggers schema, and migration notes.

alex: Action items: @chen update API by EOD Wed, @maria deliver mockups and copy, @tay add telemetry hooks for breadcrumbs + timeline, @sre-pete draft audit log schema. Sync Thurs 10am in #eng-platform. :thumbsup:
